handoff: v118 turns the private-repo plan into copy-ready issue bodies, so repo creation is followed by a real backlog rather than a blank task list.
Each issue carries owner, milestone, labels, file scope, acceptance checks, and proof commands to reduce ambiguity before coding starts.
The first backend backlog protects the product principle: operational trackers stay simple, while commercial, audit, billing, and management proof stay controlled.
v119 should convert the CI blueprint and issue proof into branch protection settings, required checks, environment gates, and release rituals.
